# Cub Scout Pack 1125 — Leaders and Trailblazers

> A family-centered Cub Scout pack in Dumfries, Virginia, founded November 2025. Serves families at Covington-Harper, Swans Creek, Triangle, and Leesylvania Elementary Schools. Part of the National Capital Area Council, Scouting America.

- Who can join: all youth in kindergarten through 5th grade, boys and girls
- Meetings: pack meeting 1st Thursday, den meeting 3rd Thursday, 6:30–7:30 PM, Covington-Harper Elementary School, Dumfries VA
- Dues: $100 per year, plus Scouting America registration ($85) and the NCAC first-year participation fee ($80). Financial aid is available through NCAC.
- Contact: admin@pack1125.org
- Council: National Capital Area Council (https://ncacscouting.org)
